en: harm done to a person’s or an animal’s body, for example in an accident
ex: Two people sustained minor injuries.
两人受轻伤。

zh: 伤停补时（足球、曲棍球等比赛为弥补因队员受伤处理而延迟结束的时间）
en: time added at the end of a game of football (soccer), hockey, etc. because the game has been interrupted by injured players needing treatment
ex: They scored two goals in injury time.
他们在伤停补时阶段进了两个球。

zh: 不公正，不公平（的对待或行为）
en: the fact of a situation being unfair and of people not being treated equally; an unfair act or an example of unfair treatment
ex: We are committed to fighting against poverty and injustice.
我们致力于与贫困和不公正作斗争。

en: coloured liquid for writing, drawing and printing
ex: written in ink
用墨水写的
